verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises the ability to 'query and edit large codebases,' backed by a 1M-token context window, --include-directories for multi-folder context, and GEMINI.md project context files, and one HN user reports it 'navigating and learning' large codebases effortlessly. However, other hands-on reports directly contradict this: users describe it as 'really really terrible at agentic stuff,' 'so stupid at navigation in the codebase it takes 10x as long,' and note it 'consistently ignores my GEMINI.md file' despite claiming to use it. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliable codebase-wide understanding, resolution of the GEMINI.md context-ignoring bug, and evidence of structured code-map/architecture-summary output beyond raw context stuffing.
